name: Frostearrific (she/they)
bio:
Frostearrific is an Admin on Silver Springs Survival, where she helps enforce the rules, supports the community, and answers questions. She also enjoys fishing, farming, building, and keeping a well-stocked supply of just about everything.

She originally found Silver Springs through Planet Minecraft and stayed because of the community—and because the server’s protection system gives players freedom without the hassle of a traditional claim system. These days, she especially enjoys the custom commands, features, and enchantments that make building more enjoyable.

One of her favorite memories is the first Runecrafting event, when the community joined voice chat to experience the story and combat together. She also enjoys seeing everyone come together during map resets.

Frostearrific describes herself as easygoing and is always happy to help newer players with questions, supplies, or anything else they need. Her favorite non-Minecraft games are Enshrouded and Valheim.
history: Frostearrific first became a Moderator October 12th of 2014 (along with Autumn Bun) and first became an Admin in November of 2014.
